description: This file contains bash functions for controlling LEDs on an OpenWrt system, including retrieving LED device paths, setting attributes, and managing LED states such as blinking, on, off, and heartbeat.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device tree path for a given LED ID.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the color and function designation of a LED based on device tree attributes.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Gets the label or name of a LED device based on device tree information.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute of a LED via sysfs.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures a LED to blink with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: led_on
methods.description: Turns a LED on (sets brightness to maximum).

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: Turns a LED off (sets brightness to zero).
